write:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/art/prop/paper_lantern.art
@@ -0,0 +1,138 @@
+@target prop/paper_lantern.png 1024x1024
+use face/parts { eye blush open_mouth sparkle }
+use shade/cel { cel }
+palette chochin
+  red ramp #d8392f 5
+  cream ramp #f4e4c4 5
+  lacquer ramp #3a2b30 5
+  gold ramp #e2a83e 5
+  glow #ffc463
+  core #fff2cc
+  blush #f6968c
+  iris #b8662a
+  ink #6e2a32
+  rim #b9c9ec
+  shadow #4a3036
+  blossom ramp #f6b8c4 5
+  twinkle #fff1c4
+let cel_shift = -36,-30
+def _eye side:1 lid:0
+  eye 78x92 iris:chochin.iris side:side lid:lid look:.1,.14
+def _petal
+  curve 0,14 10,4 9,-8 3,-13 0,-8 -3,-13 -9,-8 -10,4 closed tension:.45 fill:grad(down chochin.blossom.4 chochin.blossom,.6 chochin.blossom.1) name:petal_shape
+    ellipse 5,8 at:-3,-2 fill:chochin.blossom.4 a:.6 blur:3
+    curve 0,10 0,1 0,-6 stroke:chochin.blossom.1,[1.6 1.2 .6] taper:.3 a:.6
+layer halo
+  circle 360 at:512,566 fill:radial(fade(chochin.glow .45) fade(chochin.glow .16),.5 fade(chochin.glow 0) r:360)
+layer ground_shadow
+  ellipse 300,40 at:512,850 fill:fade(chochin.glow .22) blur:22
+  ellipse 190,24 at:512,846 fill:fade(chochin.shadow .4) blur:12
+  ellipse 140,14 at:512,844 fill:fade(chochin.shadow .3) blur:5
+layer handle pivot:512,306
+  let bow = [386,320 390,252 430,200 512,180 594,200 634,252 638,320]
+  curve bow stroke:chochin.lacquer,12 name:handle
+    curve [each p in bow -> p+(4,4)] stroke:chochin.lacquer.0,8 blur:2
+    curve [each p in bow -> p+(-3,-3)] stroke:mix(chochin.lacquer.4 chochin.core .5),[1 3 4 4 3 2 1] taper:.3 a:.8 blur:1
+    each x in [394 630]
+      ellipse 10,26 at:x,296 fill:chochin.glow a:.45 blur:8
+  circle 14 at:512,166 fill:none stroke:chochin.gold,5
+  fx rim 3 dir:1,1 color:chochin.rim a:.4
+  fx outline 4 color:chochin.lacquer.line
+layer paper pivot:512,566
+  curve [each j in 0..24 -> polar(1 j*15)*(240,262)+(512,566)] closed fill:radial(chochin.red.4 chochin.red.3,.3 chochin.red,.68 chochin.red.1 at:.44,.46 r:300) name:body
+    ellipse 120,150 at:400,470 fill:chochin.red.4 a:.35 blur:40
+    ellipse 170,40 at:512,356 fill:chochin.red.0 a:.6 blur:16
+    ellipse 200,50 at:540,790 fill:chochin.red.0 a:.5 blur:20
+    cel @body tone:chochin.red shift:cel_shift
+    intersect fill:none name:band_form
+      copy @body
+      subtract
+        union
+          rect 600x196 at:512,566
+          ellipse 222.6,26.7 at:512,664
+        ellipse 222.6,26.7 at:512,468
+    copy @band_form fill:radial(chochin.core chochin.cream.4,.3 chochin.cream,.7 chochin.cream.1 at:.42,.45 r:290) name:band
+      ellipse 90,70 at:410,580 fill:chochin.cream.4 a:.6 blur:30
+      ellipse 170,80 at:500,596 fill:chochin.glow a:.22 blur:40
+      cel @body tone:chochin.cream shift:cel_shift
+      each edge in [475 657]
+        curve [each j in 0..13 -> polar(1 j*15)*(225.1,27)+(512,edge)] stroke:chochin.red,3 taper:.3 a:.75
+    ellipse 150,170 at:500,580 fill:chochin.glow a:.32 blur:60
+    ellipse 90,100 at:494,576 fill:chochin.core a:.45 blur:40 blend:screen
+    each fleck in 0..80
+      let spot = polar(sqrt(rand(0 .9)) rand(0 360))
+      ellipse rand(2 5),rand(.6 1.2) at:512+230*spot.x,566+250*spot.y rot:rand(-25 25) fill:chochin.core a:.22
+    each rib in 0..16
+      let y = 356+rib*28
+      let offset = (y-566)/262
+      let half = 240*sqrt(1-offset*offset)
+      let arc = [each j in 0..13 -> polar(1 j*15)*(half,half*.12)+(512,y)]
+      curve [each p in arc -> p+(0,-6)] stroke:chochin.shadow,7 taper:.3 a:.18 blur:5 blend:multiply
+      curve arc stroke:chochin.red.line,2.6 taper:.25 a:.4 blend:multiply
+      curve [each p in arc -> p+(0,3.5)] stroke:chochin.core,2 taper:.35 a:.4 blur:1 blend:screen
+    curve [each j in 0..6 -> polar(1 200+j*9)*(216,238)+(512,566)] stroke:chochin.core,[2 5 7 7 5 2] taper:.3 a:.6 blur:1.5
+    curve [each j in 0..6 -> polar(1 40+j*8)*(224,246)+(512,566)] stroke:chochin.red.0,[2 5 6 5 3 1] taper:.3 a:.45
+    fx rim 5 dir:1,1 color:chochin.rim a:.45
+    fx grain .04 scale:2
+    fx outline 6 color:chochin.red.line
+layer cap_bottom pivot:512,810
+  subtract fill:none name:cap_bottom_form
+    union
+      rect 260x40 at:512,810
+      ellipse 130,15.6 at:512,830
+    ellipse 130,15.6 at:512,790
+  copy @cap_bottom_form fill:grad(right chochin.lacquer.3 chochin.lacquer,.3 chochin.lacquer.1,.7 chochin.lacquer.0) name:cap_bottom
+    ellipse 130,15.6 at:512,794 fill:chochin.lacquer.0 a:.6 blur:6
+    curve [each j in 0..13 -> polar(1 j*15)*(130,15.6)+(512,812)] stroke:chochin.gold,3 a:.9
+    curve [each j in 1..12 -> polar(1 j*15)*(126,14)+(512,792)] stroke:chochin.glow,2 taper:.3 a:.5 blur:1
+    ellipse 9,18 at:416,814 fill:mix(chochin.lacquer.4 chochin.core .4) a:.55 blur:4
+    fx rim 3 dir:1,1 color:chochin.rim a:.5
+    fx grain .03 scale:1.5
+    fx outline 5 color:chochin.lacquer.line
+layer cap_top pivot:512,323
+  union fill:none name:cap_top_form
+    rect 260x38 at:512,323
+    ellipse 130,15.6 at:512,304
+    ellipse 130,15.6 at:512,342
+  copy @cap_top_form fill:grad(right chochin.lacquer.3 chochin.lacquer,.3 chochin.lacquer.1,.7 chochin.lacquer.0) name:cap_top
+    ellipse 130,15.6 at:512,304 fill:grad(right chochin.lacquer.4 chochin.lacquer.1)
+    ellipse 104,11 at:512,305 fill:chochin.lacquer.0
+      ellipse 92,8 at:0,4 fill:radial(chochin.core chochin.glow,.55 fade(chochin.glow .3) at:.5,.7) blur:3
+    curve [each j in 0..13 -> polar(1 j*15)*(130,15.6)+(512,324)] stroke:chochin.gold,3 a:.9
+    curve [each j in 1..12 -> polar(1 j*15)*(128,14.6)+(512,305)] stroke:chochin.lacquer.4,2.4 taper:.3 a:.7 blur:.6
+    ellipse 9,17 at:416,328 fill:mix(chochin.lacquer.4 chochin.core .4) a:.55 blur:4
+    fx rim 3 dir:1,1 color:chochin.rim a:.5
+    fx grain .03 scale:1.5
+    fx outline 5 color:chochin.lacquer.line
+  each x in [388 636]
+    circle 9 at:x,318 fill:grad(down chochin.gold.4 chochin.gold,.5 chochin.gold.1) stroke:chochin.gold.line,2
+    circle 2.6 at:x-2.6,315 fill:chochin.core a:.9
+  ellipse 84,22 at:512,298 fill:chochin.glow a:.35 blur:16 blend:screen
+layer petals
+  _petal at:322,866 rot:-62 scale:1.2
+  _petal at:356,884 rot:24
+  _petal at:706,872 rot:48 scale:1.1
+  _petal at:838,560 rot:-20 scale:.9
+  fx rim 2 dir:1,1 color:chochin.rim a:.4
+  fx outline 2.5 color:chochin.blossom.line
+layer motes
+  each mote in [206,500,6 806,420,5 778,752,4 228,738,3.5 600,136,3]
+    circle mote.2*5 at:mote.0,mote.1 fill:radial(fade(chochin.glow .6) fade(chochin.glow 0) r:mote.2*5)
+    circle mote.2*.7 at:mote.0,mote.1 fill:chochin.core
+layer cheeks
+  each x in [374 650]
+    blush 70x32 at:x,644 color:chochin.blush lines:3
+layer eyes pivot:512,590
+  _eye side:-1 at:432,590 name:eye_l
+  _eye side:1 at:592,590 name:eye_r
+  assert level(@eye_l @eye_r) tol:.5
+layer eyes_closed pivot:512,590 a:0
+  _eye side:-1 lid:1 at:432,590
+  _eye side:1 lid:1 at:592,590
+layer mouth
+  open_mouth 36 at:512,646 color:chochin.ink
+layer sparkle
+  sparkle 52 at:250,300 color:chochin.twinkle
+  sparkle 30 at:790,250 color:chochin.twinkle
+  sparkle 22 at:812,660 color:chochin.twinkle
+assert inside(@body canvas margin:24)
